overview: Aegis Quantum is a trading terminal that generates calibrated, multi-model trading signals with backtested confidence, volume profile analysis, and adaptive regime detection for retail and intraday traders.
features: Multi-model signal generation: mean reversion, momentum, and pairs trading alongside indicator confluence
Confidence calibration so stated confidence reflects realized historical win rate
Volume profile analysis with point-of-control, value area, and buy/sell pressure
Adaptive regime detection that weights strategies by trending, ranging, or volatile markets
Extended backtesting over 3-5 years with per-model metrics, regime breakdown, and walk-forward validation
Model comparison view showing all models side-by-side on the same asset and range
Honest disclaimers that no system guarantees profit
Apple-inspired black and white minimal theme preserved
